subject: GSoC '10: rdx: Automatic Differentiation in R

messages.author: 7d2d2f522132a5e1
messages.subject: GSoC '10: rdx: Automatic Differentiation in R
parts:
Hi all,

After a lot of work I am happy to announce our (with my mentor Prof. John Nash) proposal for enabling Automatic Differentiation of native R code. The proposal is still not final and is only a first draft. I am embracing the release early, release often ideology so that I can incorporate the feedback, criticism of the developers in the community, in the hope that the proposal will evolve over several meaningful iterations. I will be happy to hear your feedback.

You can take a look at the proposal here at the rwiki.

Cheers,
Chillu
